solution.title: macOS Automated Device Enrollment with SSO

products.name: macOS Automated Device Enrollment with SSO — Commercial
products.short_description: Make every company Mac deploy itself and sign in with Microsoft Entra. Stand up Apple ADE + Platform SSO in Intune yourself with self-guided, tested steps — for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Company Macs that deploy themselves and sign in with corporate identity

Setting up Macs by hand doesn't scale — imaging, manual MDM steps, local admin accounts, and a personal Apple ID standing in for corporate identity. Apple Automated Device Enrollment (ADE) makes a company-owned Mac enroll into Microsoft Intune the moment it powers on — supervised, managed, and branded — and Platform SSO ties macOS sign-in to Microsoft Entra ID with a hardware-bound Secure Enclave key. Zero touch in, corporate identity out.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to roll this out. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a non-expert administrator can follow from Apple Business Manager all the way to a registered, SSO-enabled Mac — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell (Microsoft Graph) that does the checking and the heavy lifting. Implement on your own schedule and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact Apple Business Manager and Intune navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable Apple-in-enterprise consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with eight validation tests and clear pass/fail gates, so you know a Mac enrolled supervised and registered SSO before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what ADE and Platform SSO are, how they work together, the three authentication methods, and which to use (Secure Enclave key).
  • Requirements Guide — every Apple/Intune prerequisite (ABM, APNs certificate, ADE token, supervision, macOS version, Company Portal, network endpoints) with how to verify it and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click steps across four phases: connect Apple to Intune, assign devices & define the enrollment experience, deploy Company Portal + Platform SSO, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery (APNs/token expiry alarms), single-device validation, a tenant-wide macOS fleet report, safe remediation (token re-sync & re-assignment), and a one-shot Platform SSO profile builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices — including the all-important annual token/certificate lifecycle that quietly breaks Apple management when missed.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Company Macs that provision themselves on first boot, authenticate with Microsoft Entra identity via a phishing-resistant Secure Enclave key, and meet compliance for Conditional Access — deployable by a single administrator in a controlled pilot within a day.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ADEMAC-DeviceReport.ps1 — tenant-wide inventory of managed Macs and their enrollment/SSO posture
    • ADEMAC-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for macOS ADE + Platform SSO
    • ADEMAC-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation helpers for macOS ADE + Platform SSO
    • ADEMAC-Validation.ps1 — validate a single enrolled Mac against the solution's acceptance gate
    • Set-PlatformSSOProfile.ps1 — create & assign the macOS Platform SSO (Microsoft Enterprise SSO) profile

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
